name: error-budget-policy
description: One of four release-engineering phase-2 norm plugins: the error-budget hard stop. error-budget-gate.sh refuses ops/state.md's steady -> readiness transition outright when error_budget reads exhausted, regardless of how ready the next change looks — non-discretionary, not an on-call-overridable judgment call. Ships the error-budget-policy skill.

dependencies.note: Requires the core plugin from tokenmaxxxer-core installed alongside this plugin. Composes with readiness-checklist, rollout-plan, and postmortem to form the release-engineering phase-2 norm.
